product.name: COOLMAX® Loose Fit T-shirt
product.description: Loose-fit T-shirt in heavyweight jersey with a generous but not oversized silhouette. Ribbed crew neck, dropped shoulders, and a straight-cut hem. Made with COOLMAX® functional fabric – a unique, soft, comfortable, and fast-drying polyester fiber to efficiently wick moisture while regulating temperature.
